summary.text: Chris Lanier is the Republican candidate for the Tennessee House of Representatives, District 67, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He has served on the Clarksville-Montgomery County School System Board of Education, District 6, since September 2024.

paragraphs.text: Chris Lanier won the Republican primary for Clarksville-Montgomery County School System Board of Education District 6 on March 5, 2024, defeating incumbent Charlie Patterson and Maribeth Knight, and he assumed office on September 1, 2024; his term ends on September 1, 2028.

Lanier advanced from the Republican primary for Tennessee House District 67 on August 6, 2026, with 2,511 votes in an uncontested primary, and faces incumbent Democrat Ronnie Glynn in the general election.
